evidence.reason: Company reports year-end 2025 employee headcount 5,421 and consolidated revenue €2,283.2m.
Current CIO/CHRO Daniel Krauss owns both technology and people; Dorit leads people organization.
Current public profile identifies HR executive and Workday-focused recruitment, but no mutual connection or willingness to purchase established.
MobileIron's February 6, 2019 release confirms Flix deployed its cloud/mobile security platform; historical adjacent IT spend, not recent testing procurement.
Adaptive 4.0 remodeling targets five-to-ten-year planning and performance improvements, providing an active change topic without a dated procurement deadline.

why_now: Adaptive Planning is integrated with Workday HCM and being remodeled for long-range planning. Continued international expansion and Workday-focused people technology hiring create a plausible need to validate FTE feeds, permissions and planning-model changes. Installed mobile-security spend and revenue scale do not establish a new Mando budget.
persona: People technology and controlling systems owners, with CIO/CHRO sponsor
level: Functional head, senior vice president and C-suite
gaps: Exact HCM and Adaptive Planning launch dates unavailable.
No verified direct buyer email/phone, team mutual or demonstrated willingness to act.
No recent external test-automation purchase or committed procurement timeline.
FY2025 revenue is confirmed but current liquidity/profitability and allocated testing spend are not.
research_notes: Workday story confirms in-house planning developers; do not assume dependence on external consultants. Flix North America has separate regional people leadership and its employees are within group ESG scope. No scores changed.
